lyricConnections.explanationJa: 親しい相手を誇らしく人に紹介する、という意味。恋人を友達に紹介する場面で使っています。
「私に必要なのはそれだけ」という意味。相手の提案に「それだけで十分」と答えるときにも使えます。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: You’ve been talking about me to your friends?
sentences.displayHtml: You’ve been talking about me to your friends?

conversation.japanese: 友達に私のこと話してたの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Of course. I wanted to show you off.
sentences.displayHtml: Of course. I wanted to show you off.

conversation.japanese: もちろん。君を紹介して自慢したかったんだ。

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.japanese: もう。それ聞いて緊張してきた。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Relax. They’re probably more nervous than you.
sentences.displayHtml: Relax. They’re probably more nervous than you.

conversation.japanese: 大丈夫。たぶん向こうのほうが緊張してる。

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.japanese: なんで友達が緊張するの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I told them you have a really good memory.
sentences.displayHtml: I told them you have a really good memory.

conversation.japanese: 君はすごく記憶力がいいって言ってあるから。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: So they’d better be nice to me.
sentences.displayHtml: So they’d better be nice to me.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、私に優しくしないとね。

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.japanese: そういうこと。もう行ける？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Just promise we can grab pizza afterward.
sentences.displayHtml: Just promise we can grab pizza afterward.

conversation.japanese: 帰りにピザを食べるって約束して。

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.japanese: ううん。それだけで十分。
